description: This file contains a PHP class 'Option' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Catalog'. It handles CRUD operations and listing functionalities for product options in the OpenCart e-commerce system. The class includes methods for displaying an index page, listing options with pagination, rendering forms for adding/editing options, and processing save actions.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for managing product options in the admin catalog section, providing CRUD and listing functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the options page, including listing and buttons for add/edit/delete.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a JSON list of options with pagination, sorting, and sorting order.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the options list, including table data, filters, sorting links, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an option, populated with existing data when editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submission for saving a new or existing option.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected options, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for options based on filter_name query parameter, returning JSON data.
